carried_to_review.statement: The contract asks for a BCa 95% bootstrap CI 'stratified by seed'. Each cell holds exactly one margin per seed, so resampling WITHIN a seed stratum is degenerate -- it returns that seed's single value every time and yields a zero-width interval. The implementation took the SEED as the resampling unit and resampled the five seed-level values.
carried_to_review.blast_radius_as_the_producer_states_it: It affects only the CI endpoints. No margin, pass_count or verdict depends on it: those are computed from the per-seed margins directly and never from the bootstrap. The per-seed margins are retained in every run's raw-result.json, so any other CI can be recomputed without re-running anything.
carried_to_review.coordinator_action_invited_by_the_produc: If a different resampling unit was intended, that is a further versioned amendment.
carried_to_review.resolution_status: OPEN and RECORDED. This receipt neither ratifies nor rejects the interpretation. The review_plan's own procedure_deviations list was empty at authorship and is appended by the Coordinator in the ledger-archive decision record of TASK-20260907-33a736; a snapshot archive does not edit the frozen plan.
